references.label: W-A-R top lanes
references.description: The three rollover lanes above the pop bumpers advance Bonus X and their matching color values.

references.label: Red color bank
references.description: The left-side three-target bank qualifies the red base when completed.

references.label: Yellow color bank
references.description: The center three-target bank qualifies the yellow base when completed.

references.label: Blue color bank
references.description: The right-side three-target bank qualifies the blue base when completed.

references.label: Red, yellow, and blue bases
references.description: The three base shots lock balls and advance the numbered base awards.

references.label: Ion Cannon ramp
references.description: The single ramp collects Ion Cannon during three-ball play and returns toward the right flipper.
